    The left Freyd category and its kernel realization #

    This file supplies the left-handed part of the Freyd-category API that is not yet present in Mathlib. It also constructs the kernel realization used in the Auslander--Bongartz--Gabriel argument: arrows between projective-injective objects, modulo left homotopy, map to their kernels.
